rules.content:
/*
CrazyHunter ransomware
*/

rule CrazyHunter_Ransomnote
{
    meta:
        author = "ransomware.live"
        family = "ransomware.crazyhunter"
        description = "Detects CrazyHunter ransomware ransom note"
        date = "2026-05-04"
        severity = 7
        score = 70

    strings:
        $s1 = "CrazyHunter" ascii nocase
        $s2 = "CRAZYHUNTER" ascii
        $s3 = "crazy-hunter" ascii nocase

    condition:
        any of them
}
